items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution (RCE) through Magento's template system, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix.

items.title: Security Updates Available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including several Stored XSS and Incorrect Authorization flaws that could lead to privilege escalation and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that can lead to privilege escalation without authentication.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Another critical Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that can lead to privilege escalation without authentication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could enable a security feature bypass, requiring authentication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation (B2B)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable privilege escalation without authentication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could enable a security feature bypass without authentication.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento admin takeover via menu injection
items.summary: This security update resolves seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to private data.

items.title: Security Updates Available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type)
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output)
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce due to improper encoding or escaping of output, exploitable without authentication or user interaction.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.
